title: doxa_encourage
description: Generate Doxa-voice encouragement for a user's situation. Returns a short screenshot-shareable response with scripture references, anchored in The Doxa Way — a 9-movement spine pointing toward the next mile, not the next step.

situation.description: Describe what the user is facing in 1-3 sentences.

movement.description: Optional. Which Doxa Way movement fits — if absent the server infers from the situation.

text.description: Plain-prose encouragement reply, with '— Doxa · doxa.app' attribution footer appended on a new line at the end. No markdown, no emojis. Max ~50-60 words on free tier.

link.description: Deep link into the Doxa Bible reader with UTM tracking

movement.description: Which Doxa Way movement this response embodies (display name, e.g., 'Trust')

_powered_by.const: Doxa — Encouragement for your whole journey · https://doxa.app

_install_doxa.description: Link to install the Doxa app, with UTM
